New setDevice() INSERT OR IGNORE + COALESCE UPDATE mirroring setSessionDevice. exportCSV: LEFT JOIN devices d, COALESCE(d.*,e.*) for legacy 12 cols (NULL device_id -> identical to pre-feature output), appended device_id+device_strap_name; header+row updated. README schema/CSV docs updated. xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.14->0.15, build reset 3->1.

Phase 1 done — BLE multi-peripheral refactor with primary-mirror facade; single-strap behavior unchanged. Added ConnectedDevice value type + @Published devices:[UUID:ConnectedDevice] + primaryDeviceID; scalar @Published props now mirror the primary device via refreshPrimaryMirror() called on every devices mutation. preferredDeviceUUID -> preferredDeviceIDs set (computed prop migrates the legacy single key once). autoConnectPreferred Bool -> Set<UUID>. willRestoreState restores ALL peripherals (fixes the latent .first bug). autoConnectOrScan reconnects all remembered (retrievePeripherals/retrieveConnectedPeripherals/scan per pending UUID). didDisconnect issues a pending reconnect for any tracked/remembered strap (per-strap background resilience — the 'backup strap' guarantee). connect/didConnect/discover/didUpdateValueFor route by peripheral.identifier; ingest(_:from:) updates the source device's entry, mirrors primary, LiveActivity.update gated to primary. select(): not-recording = switch (single-select picker, P3 adds explicit add-another); recording = add into same session. insertSample still called WITHOUT deviceID (P2 adds attribution) so single-strap CSV byte-identical. xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.15->0.16, build stays 1.

Phase 2 done — per-sample device attribution. ingest(_:from:) now passes deviceID: peripheral UUID to db.insertSample, so each sample is attributed to its source strap in one shared session (sessionID/activeSessionID/resume unchanged; sessionSampleCount stays one aggregate). persistDeviceInfo() now also registers every connected strap's identity into the devices table via db.setDevice (idempotent COALESCE accumulation of late DIS reads), and still writes the primary strap onto the session row for the unchanged session-level label. Single-strap CSV byte-identical: export COALESCEs the devices row over the session row to the same identity for the legacy 12 columns; device_id/device_strap_name (appended cols) are now populated. xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.16->0.17, build stays 1.

Phase 3 done — minimal multi-strap UI. liveSection unchanged (primary BPM = liveness check). New otherStrapsSection: one compact line per non-primary strap (small BPM + name + status dot), shown only when devices.count>1 so the single-strap screen is unchanged. DevicePickerView is now additive/non-dismissing: connected straps show a green checkmark, tapping a connected one disconnects it (hr.forget), tapping a new one adds it (no auto-dismiss), title becomes 'Straps', footer rewritten for multi-strap + per-strap single-connection caveat, Cancel->Done. deviceSection: 'Add / Change Strap' vs 'Choose Device', 'Forget All Straps', strapSummary ('N straps'); Add/Change no longer disabled while recording (enables backup/swap mid-session = px8). HeartRateManager: select() now additive; new forget(_:), secondaryDevices, connectedDeviceIDs, hasDevice, hasRememberedStrap; maybePresentPicker uses hasRememberedStrap (not stale UserDefaults key). xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.17->0.18, build 1.

Phase 4 done — single aggregate Live Activity for N straps. ContentState gains optional secondaryBPMs:[Int]?=nil (Codable-evolution safe; nil => byte-identical single-strap payload, decodes against old struct). LiveActivityController.update(secondaryBPMs:) rides the extra BPMs on the existing primary-driven shared throttle so N straps never multiply the background update budget; one activity, one throttle; start/end/adopt and the single activity ref unchanged. HeartRateManager.ingest feeds secondaryDevices' >0 BPMs on the primary's update call. Widget: primary render unchanged; a compact '+ 72 · 75' tag added to the lock-screen second row and Dynamic Island bottom only when secondaryBPMs non-empty; compact/minimal stay primary-only. xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED (app + widget extension). Version 0.18->0.19, build 1.

Phase 5 done — exportCSV gains optional deviceID:String?=nil predicate (s.device_id = ?), composed with the existing per-session/date-range predicate+bind builder; the no-rows guard now also covers a device filter. Additive, default nil = unchanged behavior. No per-device export UI by design — owner does the per-strap split externally in the CSV (which already carries device_id/device_strap_name from P0). xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.19->0.20, build 1.

Epic complete — all 6 phases shipped (km4.1 schema/CSV, km4.2 multi-peripheral facade, km4.3 per-sample attribution, km4.4 minimal multi-strap UI, km4.5 aggregate Live Activity, km4.6 export device predicate). The app now records from N straps simultaneously into one session, attributes every sample to its source strap, and exports it in a self-describing CSV; single-strap behavior and pre-feature CSV output are byte-identical (NULL device_id COALESCEs to the session identity). Fixed: CSV export now routes rr_ms through csvEscape (it bypassed it — was string-interpolated raw at the rr field; now uses field(8)), and csvEscape's trigger set gains ';' so a multi-value rr_ms like 873;314;387 is RFC-4180 double-quoted. This keeps it one cell even in ';'-list-separator locales (most of Europe), fixing the column misalignment on the ~83% of RR-bearing rows. Other text fields already routed through field()->csvEscape (now also ;-safe). Internal ';' join semantics, 64KB chunked streaming, and the queue.sync split unchanged; quoting extra fields is valid RFC 4180 so a strict comma parser still round-trips. README documents rr_ms semicolon semantics + that the cell is quoted. Out of scope (per issue): RR data-quality/sensor-noise. xcodebuild iphonesimulator BUILD SUCCEEDED. Version 0.21->0.22, build 1.
